prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE static opaque background plane for a 2D side-view fighting game. Generate a detailed 16:9 landscape environment, ideally 3840x2160 native if supported. The subject is the LIGHT ZONE of Silent Hill: Book of Memories (PS Vita, 2012), specifically a rectangular interior room seen in the attached gameplay references. These attached images are grids of gameplay reference frames; the output MUST be ONE uninterrupted room, not a grid, not a collage, no interface. Use the second reference sheet rows 2-3 and first reference sheet row 2 for the visual vocabulary: aged pale stone/gold-brown rectangular wall panels with dark pilasters, bright tall narrow whitish window openings, worn large square stone floor slabs with restrained dusty rose tint and dark seams, occasional shallow raised rectangular stone slab behind the play area. Keep the architectural identity, materials and colors observed in the actual game. Do not import forest, blood-world flesh, industrial gears or new occult symbols. The LIGHT ZONE is not an immaculate white fantasy temple; retain the old dark earth-brown stone, soot and sparse bright windows. Compose a side-on eye-level near-orthographic 2D fighting view across this room, shallow perspective only. A long empty continuous floor fills the bottom 28 percent, with the foot line at normalized y=0.87. Back wall and two to three window/pilaster bays behind it; visual detail must stay behind the fight lane. Central 86 percent remains unobstructed. No top-down camera. Dim ambient light with narrow white window glow, readable silhouettes, restrained realistic textured raster finish. Remove every character, enemy, health bar, minimap, menu, artifact, glowing attack or HUD from reference. No statues shaped like people, bones, graffiti text, logos, captions, border or watermark. No foreground framing elements. No new hazard or action. This output is a source-guided new fighting-camera adaptation, not an assertion of exact source geometry.

prompts.prompt: Create ONE transparent 16:9 foreground overlay at 1672x941 matching the supplied LIGHT ZONE background from Silent Hill Book of Memories. It is an independent parallax plane for the same side-view fighting stage. The supplied image is ONLY the background palette/material reference, do NOT reproduce it. Actual alpha-transparent canvas. Show only tiny near-camera fragments of its worn dark ochre stone pilasters clipped against the extreme left and extreme right canvas edges, each less than 5 percent of image width, stopping before the bottom 18 percent. Subtle irregular chipped edges and realistic material matching reference. The entire central 88 percent and the entire bottom 18 percent MUST be fully alpha transparent, no wash, dust, fog, glows, shadow rectangle or scene painted there. Do not draw floor, wall, windows, bench, any whole pillar, any character or symbols. Sparse edge trim only, one image, no grid, text or border. Keep all pixels outside these tiny side slivers transparent. No solid or checkered backdrop. Detailed raster texture, not vector shapes.

prompts.name: book_steel.bg
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE static opaque 16:9 landscape background plate for a 2D side-view fighting game. Exact subject: STEEL ZONE, Zone19 in Silent Hill: Book of Memories (PS Vita 2012), based on the supplied gameplay storyboard sheets and original Miguel Rico metal props. First two refs are grids ONLY FOR REFERENCE, output one seamless uninterrupted room, no montage. The native gameplay shows green-gray industrial metal room panels and dirty metal floor, large circular gear-shaped floor inserts, riveted rectangular wall framing, dull bright oblong/rectangular light panels and industrial doors; preserve this subdued green-gray and oxidized steel appearance. Third ref supplies the diamond-tread double-panel steel door material, fourth ref the three-spoked toothed disc motif. Do not copy text, humans, monsters, HUD, attacks, maps, menu or the black gaps between reference cells. Create a level SIDE-ON fighting camera, NOT isometric/top-down. Compose one modest industrial room with rear wall of rectangular riveted dark steel panels, one closed diamond-tread double door offset left, dim narrow institutional white light panels and very restrained green cast. A large three-spoked gear motif appears as an INERT inset into the rear floor behind the fighter footing, partly foreshortened, based on original source prop. No invented giant rotating machine, sci-fi screens, pipes everywhere or symbol runes. Wide continuous unbroken worn metal floor occupies lower 28 percent, a straight empty footing at y=0.87, with central86 percent unobstructed. Keep source room's ordinary low-ceiling utilitarian scale. Detailed realistic raster textures, enough diffuse light to read fighter silhouettes, no glossy modern spaceship finish. No characters, bodies, weapons, projectiles, fire, glowing magic, readable text, logos, watermarks, frame or collage. A source-guided fighting-camera adaptation; do not invent hidden lore.

prompts.name: film_midwich.bg
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE static opaque wide16:9 detailed background plate for a lateral 2D fighting stage, 1672x941. EXACT subject: the UPPER MIDWICH CORRIDOR in its already-transformed OTHERWORLD state from Silent Hill film2006, using this attached film frame as architectural source. The reference depicts a narrow rust-dark grated gallery with rectangular wall/window bays, exposed crossbeams above, and a circular amber glazed Brethren-symbol window at the distant end. It is NOT a game version of Midwich and NOT the bathroom, courtyard, hospital or Revelation. Reframe the same source corridor into a slightly widened near-side-on empty fighting gallery. Keep the circular amber window with its dark concentric ring and geometric metal pattern at the center rear wall, flanked by the reference's repeated heavy rectangular dark wall/window bays. Rough dark oxidized brown-red metal, stained cracked wall infill, high shadowy exposed beams, dim amber light. The room feels a school stripped to its industrial skeleton, not an ornate fantasy cathedral. Bottom28 percent is one continuous level rusty metal-grating walkway, with clear foot line at y=0.87 and no hole through the fighting lane. Existing source gallery rails may appear only at the distant/outermost corners, never in front of the central86 percent. No guardrail across the fighter plane, no post through the middle. Remove the person and every trace of her silhouette. No monsters, bugs, corpses, wires, blood spray, weapons, UI, readable text, logos or watermarks. Exclude cinematic black bars. Full frame atmosphere with enough soft light to read fighter silhouettes while preserving dark brown palette. No invented wall decorations, lockers, desk, ceiling fan or grand new architecture. Detailed realistic raster surfaces, shallow perspective. A documented source-guided new versus camera, not a claim that the widened walkway reproduces original geometry.
